instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Link an owner's receipt to the request it answers", and give it request_id; receipt.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:record-the-owners-receipt and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: request_id is a request kept by tool:take-a-request; receipt has ref, owner_ref, title and optionally summary, process_ref, observed_at and raw.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: intake-request (records:read, records:write); intake-receipt (records:read, records:write).
